verdict.rationale: Productboard publishes a well-documented REST API v2 (quickstart, Postman collection, auth via PAT/OAuth, pagination, webhooks) and an MCP server for agent integration, which lets AI-native builders programmatically interact with the product. However, there's no evidence of official language-specific client SDKs (e.g., Python/JS packages) and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, suggesting no auto-generatable SDK artifact. Missing for 10: official SDK packages in common languages, published OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer confirmation of SDK usage.
